section.content: The utility model provides a biological gene analysis device, the analysis intracavity of analysis appearance body is equipped with two slide rails, two sliding connection has the guide holder between the slide rail, the analysis intracavity of analysis appearance is fixed with electric telescopic handle, electric telescopic handle's free end with the guide holder is connected, sliding connection has the fixed plate on the guide holder, the bottom of guide holder is equipped with the shock attenuation cogged rail, the fixed plate passes through damping assembly and installs drive assembly, drive assembly with the meshing of shock attenuation cogged rail is in with the drive the fixed plate slides on the guide holder, the upper end of fixed plate is connected with the frame of placing that is used for placing the gene box, the bottom sliding connection of analysis appearance body has flexible alignment jig, flexible alignment jig is connected with a plurality of walking wheels. Can play the cushioning effect when removing the gene box, avoid removing the in-process and cause rocking of gene solution in the gene box, keep the stability that gene solution removed, be convenient for the removal of analysis appearance body simultaneously.

本实用新型提供一种生物基因分析装置，所述分析仪本体的分析腔内设有两条滑轨，两条所述滑轨之间滑动连接有导向座，所述分析仪的分析腔内固定有电动伸缩杆，所述电动伸缩杆的自由端与所述导向座连接，所述导向座上滑动连接有固定板，所述导向座的底部设有减震齿轨，所述固定板通过减震组件安装有驱动组件，所述驱动组件与所述减震齿轨啮合以驱动所述固定板在所述导向座上滑动，所述固定板的上端连接有用于放置基因盒的放置框，所述分析仪本体的底部滑动连接有伸缩调节架，所述伸缩调节架连接有若干行走轮。可在移动基因盒时，起到缓冲作用，避免移动过程中造成基因盒内基因溶液的晃动，保持基因溶液移动的稳定性，同时便于分析仪本体的移动。

Biological gene analysis deviceTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a gene analysis technical field, in particular to biological gene analysis device.

Background

A gene refers to a DNA sequence carrying genetic information and is the basic genetic unit for controlling traits. The gene analyzer can be used for analyzing genes. The gene is required to be stored in the gene box after being extracted, when the gene is required to be analyzed, the gene box is placed on a movable placing frame in the gene analyzer, and the gene box is moved to a corresponding position in the gene analyzer, so that the analysis can be realized.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

Therefore, the utility model provides a biological gene analysis device can cushion rocking of gene box removal time because of solution, keeps the stability of gene solution.

The technical scheme of the utility model is realized like this:

the utility model provides a biological gene analysis device, includes the analysis appearance body, the analysis intracavity of analysis appearance body is equipped with two slide rails, two sliding connection has the guide holder between the slide rail, the analysis intracavity of analysis appearance is fixed with electric telescopic handle, electric telescopic handle's free end with the guide holder is connected, sliding connection has the fixed plate on the guide holder, the bottom of guide holder is equipped with the shock attenuation cogged rail, the fixed plate installs drive assembly through damper, drive assembly with the meshing of shock attenuation cogged rail is in with the drive the fixed plate slides on the guide holder, the upper end of fixed plate is connected with the frame of placing that is used for placing the gene box, the bottom sliding connection of analysis appearance body has flexible alignment jig, flexible alignment jig is connected with a plurality of walking wheels.

Preferably, the damping component comprises a mounting seat and a damping pad, a damping groove is formed in the fixed plate, the mounting seat is connected with the fixed plate in a sliding mode through the damping groove, damping springs are arranged in the damping groove and located on the upper side and the lower side of the mounting seat, and the damping pad is fixed on the upper surface of the mounting seat.

Preferably, the shock attenuation rack includes shock attenuation connecting plate and rack, the rack passes through the shock attenuation connecting plate with the guide holder is connected.

Preferably, the driving assembly comprises a motor and a gear, the motor is mounted on the shock absorption pad, an output shaft of the motor is connected with the gear, and the gear is meshed with the shock absorption rack.

Preferably, the guide seat is provided with a guide groove, the fixed plate is connected with a guide pulley through a connecting rod, and the guide pulley is connected in the guide groove in a rolling manner.

Preferably, flexible alignment jig is including adjusting pole, adjustment disk, first U type pole and second U type pole, first U type pole with the both ends of second U type pole all are connected with the walking wheel, first U type pole with the middle part of second U type pole is connected with the regulation rack, be connected with two adjusting gear on the regulation pole, the regulation rack with correspond the adjusting gear meshing, the one end of adjusting the pole with the adjustment disk is connected.

Preferably, a containing groove is formed in the bottom of the analyzer body, and the walking wheel can be contained in the containing groove through the telescopic adjusting frame.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that:

the utility model provides a biological gene analysis device, can pass through electric telescopic handle, shock attenuation cogged rail and drive assembly cooperation, drive gene box and move to corresponding position in the analysis intracavity, and play the cushioning effect in the process that gene box moved, avoid causing the rocking of gene solution in the gene box in the removal process, keep the stability that gene solution removed; the walking wheel is adjusted through the telescopic adjusting frame, so that the walking wheel extends to protrude out of the bottom of the gene analyzer body, and the gene analyzer body can be moved conveniently.

Detailed Description

In order to better understand the technical content of the present invention, the following embodiments are provided, and the present invention is further described with reference to the accompanying drawings.

Example 1

Referring to fig. 1 to 6, the bio-gene analyzer provided by the present invention comprises an analyzer body 1, two slide rails 3 are disposed in an analysis chamber 2 of the analyzer body 1, a guide seat 4 is slidably connected between the two slide rails 3, an electric telescopic rod 5 is fixed in the analysis chamber 2 of the analyzer, a free end of the electric telescopic rod 5 is connected to the guide seat 4, the guide seat 4 is driven by the expansion and contraction of the electric telescopic rod 5 to move back and forth in the analysis chamber 2, a fixed plate 6 is slidably connected to the guide seat 4, wherein a guide slot 27 is disposed on the guide seat 4, the fixed plate 6 is connected to a guide pulley 29 through a connecting rod 28, the guide pulley 29 is rotatably connected to the guide slot 27, so that the fixed plate 6 can slide along the guide seat 4 stably, a shock-absorbing rack 7 is disposed at the bottom of the guide seat 4, wherein the shock-absorbing rack 7 comprises a shock-absorbing connecting plate 8 and a rack 9, the rack 9 is connected to the guide seat 4 through the shock-absorbing connecting plate 8, so as to buffer the vibration generated to the guide seat 4, the fixed plate 6 is provided with a driving assembly 14 mounted on the shock-absorbing assembly 10, the sliding gear assembly 14 is mounted on a sliding adjustment gear box 15, and a sliding adjustment mechanism 16 is mounted on the guide seat 16, wherein the sliding adjustment mechanism is mounted on the guide seat 16, the sliding adjustment mechanism is connected to a motor 16, the guide seat 16 is connected to a motor 16, the telescopic adjusting frame 18 is connected with a plurality of traveling wheels 25, so that the analyzer body 1 can be conveniently moved and can be accommodated at the bottom of the analyzer body 1.

Specifically, damper 10 includes mount pad 11 and shock pad 12, be equipped with damping groove 26 in the fixed plate 6, mount pad 11 passes through damping groove 26 with fixed plate 6 sliding connection, be equipped with in the damping groove 26 and be located the damping spring 13 of both sides about the mount pad 11, shock pad 12 is fixed in the upper surface of mount pad 11 can cushion the vibration that produces fixed plate 6 through shock pad 12 and damping spring 13, makes the gene cassette stably remove on placing frame 17.

When in use, the guide seat 4 is driven to move back and forth in the analysis cavity 2 along the slide rail 3 by adjusting the extension and retraction of the electric telescopic rod 5; the motor 15 is started, the motor 15 drives the gear 16 to rotate, the gear 16 is meshed with the damping rack 7, the fixed plate 6 can move left and right on the guide seat 4 along the damping rack 7, when the fixed plate 6 is driven to move left and right along the damping guide rail, the damping cushion 12 and the damping spring 13 can buffer the vibration of the fixed plate 6, the damping connecting plate 8 can buffer the vibration of the guide seat 4, the shaking caused in the moving process is effectively avoided, and therefore the stability of the gene culture solution in the gene cassette is kept; through the cooperation of the electric telescopic rod 5, the driving assembly 14 and the damping toothed rail 7, the gene cassette placed on the placing frame 17 can be moved to the corresponding position of gene analysis.

Example 2

Referring to fig. 5 to 7, the present embodiment is different from embodiment 1 in that: the telescopic adjusting frame 18 comprises an adjusting rod 19, an adjusting disc 20, a first U-shaped rod 21 and a second U-shaped rod 22, the first U-shaped rod 21 and the two ends of the second U-shaped rod 22 are connected with walking wheels 25, the middle of the first U-shaped rod 21 and the middle of the second U-shaped rod 22 are connected with an adjusting rack 23, two adjusting gears 24 are connected on the adjusting rod 19, the adjusting rack 23 is meshed with the corresponding adjusting gears 24, one end of the adjusting rod 19 is connected with the adjusting disc 20, a containing groove 30 is formed in the bottom of the analyzer body 1, and the walking wheels 25 can be received in the telescopic adjusting frame 18 in the containing groove 30.

When walking wheel 25 need be adjusted and the reciprocating, it rotates to rotate adjusting disc 20 and drives adjusting pole 19, and then drive and connect two adjusting gear 24 rotations on adjusting pole 19, the middle part of first U type pole 21 and second U type pole 22 is connected with adjusting rack 23, adjusting rack 23 and adjusting gear 24 meshing, therefore rotatable adjusting gear 24 can drive first U type pole 21 and second U type pole 22 and reciprocate, the both ends of first U type pole 21 and second U type pole 22 all are connected with walking wheel 25, thereby reach the purpose of adjusting walking wheel 25 and reciprocating, when not needing removal analysis appearance body 1, can make walking wheel 25 accomodate in accomodating groove 30.

The above description is only a preferred embodiment of the present invention, and should not be taken as limiting the invention, and any modifications, equivalent replacements, improvements, etc. made within the spirit and principle of the present invention should be included in the protection scope of the present invention.
